story: Rosa is in the kitchen preparing lunch. She looks out the window and thinks about her plans for today. She needs to go to the supermarket to buy a tomato. She also needs to find her pen and her fourth notebook. Then, she wants to try a new restaurant with her father.
title: Rosa's Busy Day
setting: A bright, sunny kitchen in a small house.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: A young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt.

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: A tall boy with glasses and a blue sweater.

characters.name: Emma
characters.look: A small girl with long black hair and a red dress.

sentences.en: Rosa is in the kitchen now.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt, stands in a bright kitchen.

sentences.en: She looks out the big window.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa looks out of a large glass window in the kitchen.

sentences.en: Today is a very sunny day.
sentences.zh: 今天是个非常晴朗的日子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Bright sunlight shines through the kitchen window onto the floor.

sentences.en: She wants to cut a tomato.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa holds a red tomato and a knife on a wooden table.

sentences.en: She must go to the supermarket.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa imagines a large supermarket building with many food items.

sentences.en: When will she leave the house?
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa stands by the kitchen door, thinking about leaving.

sentences.en: She finds a blue pen here.
sentences.zh: 她在这里发现了一支蓝色的笔。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa picks up a blue pen from a wooden kitchen table.

sentences.en: This is her fourth small notebook.
sentences.zh: 这是她的第四本小笔记本。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa holds a small notebook, the fourth one in a stack.

sentences.en: A funny man sits on one leg.
sentences.zh: 一个滑稽的人坐在一条腿上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A funny man with a big smile sits on a chair with one leg lifted.

sentences.en: Her father wants to try a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲想尝试一家餐厅。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tall man with a kind face points to a picture of a restaurant.
